annotations.title: Hyperliquid perp funding rate, open interest and price

description: Live Hyperliquid perpetual futures data for a coin (BTC, ETH, SOL, HYPE…): mark, oracle and mid price, hourly funding rate and its APR, premium, open interest in coins and USD, 24-hour volume and price change, and max leverage. Without a coin, the 20 most traded markets by 24-hour volume. Read from Hyperliquid's public API. Use for funding-rate checks, basis trades, derivatives dashboards and market context. Example: coin=BTC. Price $0.003/call via x402 USDC or a card key (/credits), first 25 free; failed calls free. Reads or computes only and changes nothing; each call is charged, so repeats are not free.
